name: Surak Enterprises
summary: Perth ISP founded 1991 by Mark Boulton and Malcolm Evans - among the earliest claims in Australian internet access; APNIC LIR member holding its own /24 since the 1990s; long-running SquirrelMail webmail; today also a consultancy (enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, application development).

events.details: Established by Mark Boulton and Malcolm Evans 'to provide cost effective internet access' (per company history). The 1991 date is self-reported and notably earlier than most Australian commercial ISPs; it may reflect pre-commercial-internet origins (e.g. BBS/dial-in services). Earliest verified Wayback captures of surak.com.au are user homepages from 7 Dec 1999, with the main site captured from Apr 2001.

refs.label: Surak About Us: established 1991 by Mark Boulton and Malcolm Evans
Wayback Machine: earliest capture of surak.com.au user page (7 Dec 1999)

events.details: Held its own Class C IP block (203.23.86.0/24, netname SURAKENT-AU) at 11 Earl St, Bentley WA as early as 1997 - physical evidence of infrastructure during the dialup era. Later became an APNIC LIR member (ORG-SE4-AP, contact Malcolm Evans, 150B Belgravia St, Belmont WA); route objects from the early 2000s show the block announced via Concept Networks (AS9787) with connect.com.au/Telstra transit.

refs.label: Contemporary 1997 Class C subnet listing: SURAKENT-AU, Surak Enterprises, Bentley WA
APNIC whois: ORG-SE4-AP Surak Enterprises LIR, 203.23.86.0/24

events.details: Evolved beyond consumer internet into consultancy services: enterprise architecture, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, application development and support. Co-founder Malcolm Evans worked as a consultant with the firm 2005-2017 (Perth). SquirrelMail-based webmail has run continuously for customers from the mid-2000s through at least 2024.
